heading: Get started with Misdaq
subheading: Choose a service, pick a plan and leave your details. Our team will get back to you within 24 hours.

service.label: Service
service.title: Which service do you need?
service.description: Choose the service you'd like to start with.

plan.label: Plan
plan.title: Choose your plan
plan.description: Prices are per month. Your quote will confirm the final details.

details.label: Details
details.title: Tell us about your business
details.description: We'll use these details to prepare your quote and set up your account.
details.descriptionInterest: We'll use these details to contact you as soon as {service} opens.

planAnnualNote: Save up to {percent}% with annual billing. Your quote will include both options.
earlyAccess: Early access: {service} is launching soon. Register your interest now and we'll contact you as soon as it opens. There's nothing to pay.
contactEmailHint: We'll send your quote and account invitation to this address.
errFormFix: Please check the highlighted fields and try again.
errorGeneral: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
errorTooManyRequests: You've sent several requests today. Please try again tomorrow.
errorEmailRegistered: This email already belongs to a Misdaq account. Please sign in, or use a different email.
errBrandMin: Brand name must be at least 2 characters.
errBrandMax: Brand name must be 60 characters or fewer.
errBrandRegex: Brand name can only contain letters, numbers, spaces and hyphens.
errNameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters.
errNameMax: Name must be 80 characters or fewer.
errEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
errPhone: Please enter a valid phone number.
errBranchCount: Enter a number of branches between 1 and 10,000.

success.bodyQuote: Thanks, {name}. We've received your request for {service} on the {plan} plan. Our team will contact you at {email} within 24 hours.
success.bodyInterest: Thanks, {name}. We'll contact you at {email} as soon as {service} opens.

quote.title: We send you a quote
quote.body: Our team reviews your request and contacts you with a quote that fits your branches.

activate.title: We activate your account
activate.body: Once your payment is confirmed, we activate your account and email you an invitation to sign in.

brand.title: You make it yours
brand.body: Add your logo and brand colors, then set up your branches and invite your team.

saved.title: Your details are saved
saved.body: There's nothing to pay and no commitment.

launch.title: We reach out at launch
launch.body: As soon as {service} opens, our team will contact you to get you set up.

success.spamNote: Our reply may land in your spam or junk folder, so please check there too.
